stem:
Mini shares one roti equally. She compares the unit fractions $1/3$ and $1/9$ from that whole.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: $1/9$ is greater than $1/3$ because 9 is greater than 3.
$1/3$ is greater than $1/9$ because fewer equal shares make each share larger.
$1/3$ and $1/9$ are equal because each numerator is 1.
$1/9$ is greater because the denominator is the size of the share.

teacher.key_rationale: From the same whole, fewer equal shares make each unit share larger, so 1/3 > 1/9. Treating a larger denominator as a larger share reverses the relation. Equal numerators alone are a surface cue. Calling the denominator the share size swaps terms.
